desc: Derive and verify the per-pair inversion condition on k-intervals for the three cases (y > x, y == x, y < x)
Design incremental O((N+M) log N) approach: track inversion-count delta as elements wrap from M-1 to 0 using position BIT(s)
Implement solve(): I/O, M=1 edge case, initial inversion count via value BIT, position lists per value, BIT initialization
Verify correctness by tracing Samples 1-3 by hand; found bug: `after` must use earlier_in_S (zeros at state k+1 are exactly S), not the old zero-set
Fix the delta formula in solve(): drop bit_zero, use after = (p-1) - bit_max.sum(p-1), before = (N-p) - bit_max.range_sum(p,N), deltas computed before mutation
Finalize solution: confirm fast I/O, integer sizes, and O((N+M) log N) complexity fits 2×10^5 limits
